paite: Huan Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih nawn ua; huchi in TOUPA'N Philistiate khut ah amaute kum sawmli sung apia hi.
heading: Samson Pianna

paite: Zorah ah Dan nam mi khat a-om a, amin Manoah ahi a, azi bel achiing a, nau anei kei hi.
Numei kiang ah TOUPA angel ahong kilak a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, na chiing a, nau nei thei lou himah lechin na gai dia, tapa na nei ding hi.
Huchi in pilvang in, uain leh zu hat leh siang lou thil himhim ne het ke'n.

'Ngai in, na gai dia, tapa nei ding na hi ngal a. Alu ah mulmet tem himhim zat ahi kei ding; naupang bel sul a a-om lai a pan Pathian a dia Nazarit hi ding ahi ngal a.' Ama'n Israelte Philistia mite khut a pan hutkhiak apan ding," achi hi.

Numei in apasal kiang ah, "Pathian mipa khat ka kiang ah ahong a, amel Pathian angel mel bang ahi a, kihtakhuaitak ahi. Koilam mi ahia chih bel ka dong chitchiat kei a, ama'n lah amin ahon hilh sam kei hi.

Himahleh ka kiang ah, Ngai in, na gai dia, tapa na nei ding. Huchi in uain leh zu hat himhim dawn ke'nla, siang lou thil himhim leng ne het ke'n. Naupang sul a a-om lai a pan asih tan in Pathian a dia Nazarit mi hi ding ahi, achi,” chi in agen hi.

Huchi in Manoah in TOUPA kiang ah nget chihtak in angen a, akiang ah, "Aw TOUPA hehpih in huai Pathian mipa na hon sawl ka kiang uah hong nawn henla, naupang hong piang ding bang ka chih ding ua hong sinsak hen," achi hi.
Pathian in Manoah thugen ana ngaikhia hi. Loubuk a numei atut lai in akiang ah Pathian angel ahong nawn hi. Apasal Manoah bel akiang ah a-om kei hi.
Numei kintak in atai pah a, apasal ava hilh a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, zanlam a ka kiang a hong hohpa ka kiang ah ahong kilak nawn," achi hi.
Huchi in Manoah athou a, azi azui a, huai mi kiang ava tung uhi. Akiang ah, "Numei kiang a thu gen nang na hi maw?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hi e,” achi hi.
Manoah in, “Na thu bang zel in hong tung hen. Naupang omdan ding bangchibang ahi dia, asep ding bang ahi dia le?" achi hi.
TOUPA angel in Manoah kiang ah, "Numei kiang a ka gen tengteng ah amah pilvang hen.
Grepgui a pan mawngmawng ane ding ahi kei a, uain leh zu hat adawn ding ahi kei. Siang lou thil mawngmawng leng ane ding ahi kei. Ka thupiak tengteng zui hen," achi hi.
Manoah in TOUPA angel kiang ah, "Ka hong thum uh. Hehpih in hon ompih lai in, kelnou ka hon bawlsak khit matan uh," achi hi.

TOUPA angel in Manoah kiang ah, "Hon khou lechin leng na an zaw ka ne kei ding. Haltum thil lan ding na hihleh TOUPA kiang a na lat ngeingei ding ahi,” achi hi. Manoah in lah TOUPA angel ahi chih athei ngal kei hi.
Manoah in TOUPA angel kiang ah, "Na min bang ahia, na thugen bang a hong tun chiang a ka hon pahtawi theihna ding un?" achi hi.
TOUPA angel in akiang ah, "Bangziak a ka min hon dong na hia, lamdang ahi chih theizen napi a?" achi hi.
Huchi in Manoah in kelnou khat leh nek ding thillat ala a; suangpi tung ah TOUPA kiang ah alan hi. Angel in thillamdangtak ahih a, Manoah leh azi in a-en nilouh uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, maitam a pan meikuang van lam a akahtouh lai in, maitam a meikuang ah TOUPA angel apaitouta hi. Manoah leh azi in a-en nilouh ua, amaitang un lei asi uhi.
Himahleh TOUPA angel Manoah leh azi kiang ah ahong kilak nawn kei hi. Huchi in Manoah in TOUPA angel ahi chih atheita hi.
Manoah in azi kiang ah, "Pathian i muh ziak in i si ngeingei ding,” achi hi.

Himahleh azi in akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hon hihlup tum hileh halmang thillat leh nek ding thillat i latte asang kei ding. Hiai thil tengteng leng ahon ensak kei ding a, tu hun in hiai thilte leng hon hilh kei ding," achi hi.
Numei in tapa aneita a, amin Samson asa uh. Naungek ahong khanglian a, TOUPA'N avualzawl hi.
Zorah leh Eshtaol kikal ah Mahaneh Dan mun ah TOUPA kha in atokthouta hi.
